titleEn: Please give me your passport and air ticket

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as bànlǐ. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 办理 like the word you’ll use at the airport check-in desk — go through formalities before you fly.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers pair 办理 with 手续 (办理登机手续). In 课文1, 关建平 tells 夏雨 they will check in and consign the bags first.

example.zh: 我们先去办理登机手续，把行李托运了。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bǎ xíngli tuōyùn le.
example.en: Let’s go handle the boarding formalities first and check the luggage.

words.note: Book lists 登机 without a POS mark (verb-object). Headword pinyin printed as dēng jī. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 登机 like the airport step after check-in — boarding the plane, often inside 登机手续 / 登机牌儿.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers keep 登机 as a set VO: 登机手续, 登机牌. In 课文1 it sits inside 办理登机手续.

example.zh: 我们先去办理登机手续，把行李托运了。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bǎ xíngli tuōyùn le.
example.en: Let’s go handle the boarding formalities first and check the luggage.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as shǒuxù. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 手续 like the paperwork steps you must 办理 before the airline takes your bags.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 办手续 / 办理……手续. In 课文1 it is specifically 登机手续 at the counter.

example.zh: 我们先去办理登机手续，把行李托运了。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bǎ xíngli tuōyùn le.
example.en: Let’s go handle the boarding formalities first and check the luggage.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as xíngli (neutral li). Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 行李 like the bags you 托运 or put in the overhead bin — not a small purse alone.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 行李 for travel bags. 课文1 checks them; later 关建平 says 把手提包放到行李箱里去吧.

example.zh: 我们先去办理登机手续，把行李托运了。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bǎ xíngli tuōyùn le.
example.en: Let’s go handle the boarding formalities first and check the luggage.

words.en: to consign for shipment; to check (baggage)
words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as tuōyùn. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 托运 like handing a suitcase to the airline so it rides in the hold, not in the cabin.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 托运 行李 / 箱子. In 课文1 the clerk asks which suitcase to check and says 把它放上去吧.

example.zh: 请把护照和机票给我。哪个箱子要托运？把它放上去吧。这是登机牌儿，请拿好。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hùzhào hé jīpiào gěi wǒ. Nǎge xiāngzi yào tuōyùn? Bǎ tā fàng shàngqù ba. Zhè shì dēngjīpáir, qǐng ná hǎo.
example.en: Please give me your passport and air ticket. Which suitcase needs to be checked? Put it up there. Here’s the boarding pass — please take it.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as hùzhào. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 护照 like the ID the check-in clerk asks for with your 机票.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers hand over 护照 at the counter. Lesson title and 课文1 open on 请把护照和机票给我.

example.zh: 请把护照和机票给我。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hùzhào hé jīpiào gěi wǒ.
example.en: Please give me your passport and air ticket.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as jīpiào. Sub-entry 票 listed under it. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 机票 like the flight ticket you show with your passport at check-in.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 机票 for a plane ticket (not 车票). Paired with 护照 in the lesson title and 课文1.

example.zh: 请把护照和机票给我。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hùzhào hé jīpiào gěi wǒ.
example.en: Please give me your passport and air ticket.

words.note: Book sub-entry under 机票; pinyin printed as piào. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 票 like the general “ticket” morpheme inside 机票, 车票, etc.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers rarely say bare 票 for a flight — they specify 机票. Learn it here as the bound piece under 机票.

example.zh: 请把护照和机票给我。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hùzhào hé jīpiào gěi wǒ.
example.en: Please give me your passport and air ticket.

words.note: Book prints 登机牌(儿); headword pinyin as dēngjīpáir. Kept erhua form matching 课文. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 登机牌儿 like the card the clerk hands you after check-in — 请拿好.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 登机牌 / 登机牌儿. In 课文1: 这是登机牌儿，请拿好.

example.zh: 这是登机牌儿，请拿好。
example.pinyin: Zhè shì dēngjīpáir, qǐng ná hǎo.
example.en: Here’s the boarding pass — please take it.

words.en: to load; to pack; to hold
words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as zhuāng. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 装 like putting something into a pocket, bag, or device — 装的是什么 / 把电池装上.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 装 for packing/holding and for installing (装电池). 课文1 asks what’s in the pocket; later 关建平 把电池装上.

example.zh: 这位女士，你口袋里装的是什么？
example.pinyin: Zhè wèi nǚshì, nǐ kǒudài li zhuāng de shì shénme?
example.en: Ma’am, what do you have in your pocket?

words.en: to draw out; to pull out; to fish out
words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as tāo. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 掏 like digging something out of a pocket at security — 都掏出来.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 掏口袋 / 掏出来. Security line in 课文1: 请把口袋里的东西都掏出来.

example.zh: 请把口袋里的东西都掏出来。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kǒudài li de dōngxi dōu tāo chūlái.
example.en: Please take everything out of your pockets.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as yìngbì. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 硬币 like metal coins that set off the security gate with a few keys.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers contrast 硬币 with 纸币. 夏雨 finds 几把钥匙和两个硬币 in her pocket.

example.zh: 啊，是几把钥匙和两个硬币。
example.pinyin: À, shì jǐ bǎ yàoshi hé liǎng ge yìngbì.
example.en: Ah, it’s a few keys and two coins.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as àn. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 暗 like the cabin feeling 有点儿暗 before someone turns the reading light on.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 有点儿暗 / 太暗了. 课文2 opens: 这里边有点儿暗.

example.zh: 这里边有点儿暗。
example.pinyin: Zhè lǐbian yǒudiǎnr àn.
example.en: It’s a bit dark in here.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as kāiguān. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 开关 like the control you hunt for on the seat armrest to turn the light on.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers ask 开关在哪儿. In 课文2, 夏雨 can’t find it; 关建平 says it’s on the 扶手.

example.zh: 开关在哪儿呢？
example.pinyin: Kāiguān zài nǎr ne?
example.en: Where’s the switch?

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as fúshǒu. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 扶手 like the arm of the airplane seat where the light switch sits.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 座位的扶手. 课文2: 在座位的扶手上.

example.zh: 在座位的扶手上。
example.pinyin: Zài zuòwèi de fúshǒu shàng.
example.en: On the armrest of the seat.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as kōngjiě. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 空姐 like the flight attendant who tells everyone to fasten seat belts before takeoff.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers still say 空姐 casually (also 乘务员). In 课文2 she announces takeoff and 把手机关上.

example.zh: 飞机马上就要起飞了，请大家把安全带系好，把手机关上……
example.pinyin: Fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le, qǐng dàjiā bǎ ānquándài jì hǎo, bǎ shǒujī guān shàng……
example.en: The plane is about to take off; please fasten your seat belts and turn off your phones…

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as qǐfēi. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 起飞 like the moment the plane leaves the ground — 马上就要起飞了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 起飞 for aircraft (not cars). 课文2: 飞机马上就要起飞了.

example.zh: 飞机马上就要起飞了，请大家把安全带系好，把手机关上……
example.pinyin: Fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le, qǐng dàjiā bǎ ānquándài jì hǎo, bǎ shǒujī guān shàng……
example.en: The plane is about to take off; please fasten your seat belts and turn off your phones…

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as ānquándài; sub-entries 安全 / 带 listed under it. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 安全带 like the belt you 系好 before takeoff — 夏雨 still doesn’t know how.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 系安全带. 课文2: 请大家把安全带系好; 夏雨: 我还不会系安全带呢.

example.zh: 我还不会系安全带呢。
example.pinyin: Wǒ hái bú huì xì ānquándài ne.
example.en: I still don’t know how to fasten a seat belt.

words.note: Book sub-entry under 安全带; pinyin printed as ānquán. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 安全 like the “safe” half of 安全带 — also appears in 安全检查门 in the stage direction.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 安全 as “safe/security.” Here learn it as the morpheme inside 安全带; the gate scene uses 安全检查门.

example.zh: 请大家把安全带系好。
example.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā bǎ ānquándài jì hǎo.
example.en: Please fasten your seat belts.

words.note: Book sub-entry under 安全带; pinyin printed as dài (noun sense here). Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 带 like the “belt” piece of 安全带 — not the verb “to bring.”
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers meet noun 带 inside compounds (安全带, 皮带). Keep this sitting’s sense as the belt, not 带东西.

example.zh: 我还不会系安全带呢。
example.pinyin: Wǒ hái bú huì xì ānquándài ne.
example.en: I still don’t know how to fasten a seat belt.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as chātóu. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 插头 like the seat-belt tongue you push in — 往里一插就行了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 插头 for an electrical plug; here the book uses it for the seat-belt buckle tongue in 课文2.

example.zh: 把这个插头往里一插就行了。
example.pinyin: Bǎ zhège chātóu wǎng lǐ yì chā jiù xíng le.
example.en: Just push this plug in and you’re done.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as qiǎzi. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 卡子 like the seat-belt release you 扳一下儿 to open.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 卡子 for a clip/buckle. 课文2: 把卡子扳一下儿就打开了.

example.zh: 把卡子扳一下儿就打开了。
example.pinyin: Bǎ qiǎzi bān yíxiàr jiù dǎkāi le.
example.en: Just flip the buckle and it opens.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as bān; gloss: change the direction of a fixed object / turn. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 扳 like flipping the seat-belt buckle — 扳一下儿.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 扳 for turning a fixed lever/buckle. In 课文2 it opens the 卡子.

example.zh: 把卡子扳一下儿就打开了。
example.pinyin: Bǎ qiǎzi bān yíxiàr jiù dǎkāi le.
example.en: Just flip the buckle and it opens.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as liáng. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 凉 like coffee that sat too long on the tray — 都凉了, drink it.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say food/drink 凉了. 课文2: 咖啡都凉了，快把它喝了吧.

example.zh: 啊，打开了。你看，咖啡都凉了，快把它喝了吧。
example.pinyin: À, dǎkāi le. Nǐ kàn, kāfēi dōu liáng le, kuài bǎ tā hē le ba.
example.en: Ah, it’s open. Look, the coffee’s gone cold — drink it up.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as bēizi. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 杯子 like the cup 关建平 knocks over when he pulls out the magazine.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 杯子 for a cup/glass. 课文2: 你把杯子碰倒了，咖啡全洒了.

example.zh: 你把杯子碰倒了，咖啡全洒了。
example.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ bēizi pèngdǎo le, kāfēi quán sǎ le.
example.en: You knocked the cup over — the coffee all spilled.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as sǎ. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 洒 like liquid spreading across the tray table after the cup falls.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 洒 for spilling liquid. 课文2 closes the spill with 咖啡全洒了 and 快拿纸把桌子擦擦.

example.zh: 你把杯子碰倒了，咖啡全洒了。
example.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ bēizi pèngdǎo le, kāfēi quán sǎ le.
example.en: You knocked the cup over — the coffee all spilled.

words.note: Listed under 专名. Book pinyin printed as Guān Jiànpíng. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Treat it as a proper name — the husband flying with 夏雨.
words.usage: Treat it as a proper name. Don’t translate it; he is a speaker and appears in stage directions.

example.zh: 我们先去办理登机手续，把行李托运了。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bǎ xíngli tuōyùn le.
example.en: Let’s go handle the boarding formalities first and check the luggage.

words.note: Listed under 专名. Book pinyin printed as Xià Yǔ. Example-sentence / dialogue-line pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Treat it as a proper name — 关建平’s wife, first time flying.
words.usage: Treat it as a proper name. Don’t translate it; she is a speaker throughout both 课文.

example.zh: 没有什么呀！
example.pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme ya!
example.en: Nothing (particular)!

dialogues.label: 课文1
dialogues.headingEn: Please give me your passport and air ticket

lines.zh: 关建平和妻子夏雨一起坐飞机去国外旅行，夏雨是第一次乘飞机……
lines.pinyin: Guān Jiànpíng hé qīzi Xià Yǔ yìqǐ zuò fēijī qù guówài lǚxíng, Xià Yǔ shì dì-yī cì chéng fēijī……
lines.en: Guan Jianping and his wife Xia Yu are heading abroad by plane. This is Xia Yu’s first time flying…

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 我们先去办理登机手续，把行李托运了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù, bǎ xíngli tuōyùn le.
lines.en: Let’s go handle the boarding formalities first and check the luggage.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.zh: 请把护照和机票给我。哪个箱子要托运？把它放上去吧。这是登机牌儿，请拿好。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hùzhào hé jīpiào gěi wǒ. Nǎge xiāngzi yào tuōyùn? Bǎ tā fàng shàngqù ba. Zhè shì dēngjīpáir, qǐng ná hǎo.
lines.en: Please give me your passport and air ticket. Which suitcase needs to be checked? Put it up there. Here’s the boarding pass — please take it.

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 谢谢！
lines.pinyin: Xièxie!
lines.en: Thank you!

lines.zh: 夏雨通过安全检查门时，安全检查门发出响声……
lines.pinyin: Xià Yǔ tōngguò ānquán jiǎnchá mén shí, ānquán jiǎnchá mén fāchū xiǎngshēng……
lines.en: The alarm goes off as Xia Yu passes through the security portal…

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.zh: 这位女士，你口袋里装的是什么？
lines.pinyin: Zhè wèi nǚshì, nǐ kǒudài li zhuāng de shì shénme?
lines.en: Ma’am, what do you have in your pocket?

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 没有什么呀！
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme ya!
lines.en: Nothing (particular)!

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.zh: 请把口袋里的东西都掏出来。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kǒudài li de dōngxi dōu tāo chūlái.
lines.en: Please take everything out of your pockets.

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 啊，是几把钥匙和两个硬币。
lines.pinyin: À, shì jǐ bǎ yàoshi hé liǎng ge yìngbì.
lines.en: Ah, it’s a few keys and two coins.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.zh: 好了。请进去吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo le. Qǐng jìnqù ba.
lines.en: All right. Please go in.

lines.zh: 在飞机上
lines.pinyin: Zài fēijī shàng
lines.en: On the plane

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 把手提包放到行李箱里去吧。
lines.pinyin: Bǎ shǒutíbāo fàng dào xínglixiāng li qù ba.
lines.en: Put the handbag up in the overhead bin.

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 等一下儿，先把相机拿出来，我想在飞机上照两张照片。
lines.pinyin: Děng yíxiàr, xiān bǎ xiàngjī ná chūlái, wǒ xiǎng zài fēijī shàng zhào liǎng zhāng zhàopiàn.
lines.en: Wait a second — take the camera out first; I want to take a couple of photos on the plane.

lines.zh: 关建平把相机从手提包里拿出来
lines.pinyin: Guān Jiànpíng bǎ xiàngjī cóng shǒutíbāo li ná chūlái
lines.en: Guan Jianping takes the camera out of the handbag

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 给你。对了，相机里还没有电池呢，我先把电池装上。
lines.pinyin: Gěi nǐ. Duì le, xiàngjī li hái méiyǒu diànchí ne, wǒ xiān bǎ diànchí zhuāng shàng.
lines.en: Here. Oh right — there are no batteries in the camera yet; I’ll put them in first.

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 这里边有点儿暗。
lines.pinyin: Zhè lǐbian yǒudiǎnr àn.
lines.en: It’s a bit dark in here.

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 你把灯打开。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ dēng dǎkāi.
lines.en: Turn on the light.

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 开关在哪儿呢？
lines.pinyin: Kāiguān zài nǎr ne?
lines.en: Where’s the switch?

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 在座位的扶手上。
lines.pinyin: Zài zuòwèi de fúshǒu shàng.
lines.en: On the armrest of the seat.

lines.speaker: 空姐
lines.zh: 飞机马上就要起飞了，请大家把安全带系好，把手机关上……
lines.pinyin: Fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le, qǐng dàjiā bǎ ānquándài jì hǎo, bǎ shǒujī guān shàng……
lines.en: The plane is about to take off; please fasten your seat belts and turn off your phones…

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 我还不会系安全带呢。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái bú huì xì ānquándài ne.
lines.en: I still don’t know how to fasten a seat belt.

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 把这个插头往里一插就行了。
lines.pinyin: Bǎ zhège chātóu wǎng lǐ yì chā jiù xíng le.
lines.en: Just push this plug in and you’re done.

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 怎么打开呢？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme dǎkāi ne?
lines.en: How do you open it?

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 把卡子扳一下儿就打开了。
lines.pinyin: Bǎ qiǎzi bān yíxiàr jiù dǎkāi le.
lines.en: Just flip the buckle and it opens.

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 啊，打开了。你看，咖啡都凉了，快把它喝了吧。
lines.pinyin: À, dǎkāi le. Nǐ kàn, kāfēi dōu liáng le, kuài bǎ tā hē le ba.
lines.en: Ah, it’s open. Look, the coffee’s gone cold — drink it up.

lines.zh: 关建平把小桌下边的画报抽出来，不小心把杯子碰倒了
lines.pinyin: Guān Jiànpíng bǎ xiǎozhuō xiàbian de huàbào chōu chūlái, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ bēizi pèngdǎo le
lines.en: Guan Jianping pulls the pictorial from under the tray table and knocks the cup over by accident

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 哎呀！
lines.pinyin: Āiyā!
lines.en: Oh no!

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 怎么了？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme le?
lines.en: What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: 夏雨
lines.zh: 你把杯子碰倒了，咖啡全洒了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ bēizi pèngdǎo le, kāfēi quán sǎ le.
lines.en: You knocked the cup over — the coffee all spilled.

lines.speaker: 关建平
lines.zh: 快拿纸把桌子擦擦。
lines.pinyin: Kuài ná zhǐ bǎ zhuōzi cācā.
lines.en: Quick, get some paper and wipe the table.

notes.title: 没有什么呀！
notes.body: 注释：句中的“什么”不表示疑问，而表示不肯定的事物。English: “什么” here does not ask a question; it refers to something indefinite / nothing particular.

example.zh: 没有什么呀！
example.pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme ya!
example.en: Nothing (particular)!

notes.title: 把字句（2）：主语是动作发出者
notes.body: 使用“把”字句的要求（1）：主语一定是谓语动词所示动作的发出者。

example.zh: 我把相机给姐姐了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ xiàngjī gěi jiějie le.
example.en: I gave the camera to my older sister.

notes.title: 把字句（2）：“把”的宾语须特指
notes.body: “把”的宾语同时也是谓语动词涉及的对象，而且必须是特指的（明指或暗指）。明指：宾语前有“这”“那”或定语等；暗指：语境中双方清楚所指。

example.zh: 请把护照和机票给我。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hùzhào hé jīpiào gěi wǒ.
example.en: Please give me your passport and air ticket.

notes.title: 把字句（2）：动词后须有其他成分
notes.body: 动词后面一定有其他成分，说明动作产生的结果或影响，如“了”、重叠动词、宾语、补语等。

example.zh: 快把桌子擦擦。
example.pinyin: Kuài bǎ zhuōzi cācā.
example.en: Quick, wipe the table.

notes.title: 把字句（2）：否定与能愿在“把”前
notes.body: 否定副词“不”“没（有）”或能愿动词应放在“把”的前边，不能放在动词的前边。

example.zh: 你没把口袋里的东西都掏出来。
example.pinyin: Nǐ méi bǎ kǒudài li de dōngxi dōu tāo chūlái.
example.en: You didn’t take everything out of your pockets.

notes.title: 把字句（2）：谓语须能使宾语变化
notes.body: “把”字句的谓语动词必须是能使宾语发生某种变化、产生某种结果的及物动词。因此“有、是、在、来、去、觉得、毕业”等不能作“把”字句的主要动词。

example.zh: 把要托运的行李放上去吧。
example.pinyin: Bǎ yào tuōyùn de xíngli fàng shàngqù ba.
example.en: Put the luggage that needs to be checked up there.
